newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Midwest direct hogs seen flat-off $1- dealers.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Midwest direct hogs seen flat-off $1- dealers.

text.p: U.S. Midwest direct cash hogs Monday were seen steady to $1.00 per cwt lower as packers were expected to again bid lower in efforts to revitalize operating margins, livestock dealers said.

Top prices for hogs delivered to interior Iowa and southern Minnesota hog plants could range from $52.50 to $53.00 and Illinois top hog prices at the plant could range $53.00 to $53.50, sources in those areas said.
Indiana/Ohio top prices for hogs at plants could range $53.00 to $53.50.
Packer operating margins reportedly were eroded by sluggish pork demand, dealers said.

Margins are poor enough that John Morrell and Co.'s hog plant in Sioux City, Iowa, reportedly will reduce operations by one shift for an indefinite period starting on Monday, company sources said. The plant has a daily estimated slaughter capacity of 15,000 to 16,000 head, industry sources said.
Neither Morrell officials nor officials from its parent company, Smithfield Foods Inc, could be reached for comment.
